prompt:
Create a clean, professional scientific diagram showing a horizontal axis representing "signal rawness" (сырость сигнала) from left to right. The axis is labeled "Рафинирование →" (meaning refinement/processing increases to the right). Below the axis, place labeled markers at different positions:

Leftmost: "Состояние системы" (machine state - registers, memory, disk blocks)
Then slightly right: "Вызовы/события уровня ОС" (syscalls, eBPF, strace)
Then: "Структурированные события" (wide events with many attributes)
Then: "Метрики" (aggregated numerical time series)
Then: "Дашборды/алерты" (pre-computed aggregates, known-questions)

Above the axis, add three brackets/labels spanning different regions:
- Left region: "Наибольшая информативность, наибольшая стоимость" 
- Middle region: "Сырые сигналы → Wide events"
- Right region: "Обработанные сигналы"

Use a clean minimalist style with a white/light gray background, dark text, and subtle blue/gray color coding. No icons or decorative elements — pure structural diagram. Text in Russian.
